描述_EN: the center of the band receives a covering network of interlacing regularly sparing a space in the center, formed by an eight-pointed star including in its center an eight-petal flower. the square features an eight-pointed star at its center, with a small ten-petal flower. the star is decorated with a network of interlocking interlaces inscribed in a square, then in a frame formed by a wide interlace. fragment of openwork and fringed fabric with square and angled band (1) of monochrome wine-red tapestry, decorated with a flying shuttle. fragment to be compared with fabric no. 900020088, preserved in the same location and probably from the same garment. a small fragment (2) of wine-red strip has come loose and is still in the same packaging. the angled band features a plain wine-red border, followed by a line of ecru posts.
描述_ZN: 带子的中心覆盖着交错的网络，有规律地在中心留下一个空间，由一个八角星组成，中心有一朵八瓣花。 该广场的中心是一个八角星，有一朵小的十瓣花。 该星饰以交错的网络，镶嵌在一个正方形中，然后在一个由宽大的交错形成的框架中。 镂空和流苏织物碎片，带方形和斜角的单色酒红色挂毯（1），装饰有飞梭。 碎片与保存在同一地点的第900020088号织物进行比较，可能来自同一件衣服。 一小块酒红色条状物（2）已经松动，仍在同一包装中。 有棱有角的带子上有一个普通的酒糟边，然后是一排乌黑的柱子。
时期: 埃及 罗马统治时期；拜占庭统治时期
